summary: Steep bush trail behind houses with no vehicle access and a house 19 m away.
reasons: Footpath in bush, no vehicle tracks

drivers.seclusion: Bush on the west, but houses sit 19 to 35 m to the east of the pin.
drivers.access_and_room: Only a narrow dirt walking trail reaches the pin; no tyre tracks or vehicles seen, and the nearest road is a cul-de-sac turning head about 100 m south.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street to the south.
drivers.convention: No sign anyone parks or stays here.

sun_shade: Eucalypt canopy shades most of the trail.
cannot_judge: Whether a gate sits at the trail head
